Raise Security Standards—Win Client Confidence, Reduce Risk

We help Sri Lankan SMEs build guard-force SOPs, run training & drills, standardise incident reporting, and align with buyer programs (CSR/CTPAT-style requirements)—without slowing day-to-day operations.

Problem

Guard posts run differently per site; documentation is inconsistent; incidents are recorded after the fact.

Agitation

Client audits flag SOP gaps, training records go missing, and incident responses vary—hurting renewals and SLAs.

Solution

A standardised security operating system—SOPs, checklists, training, drills, and audits—rolled out site by site, with evidence ready for buyer/third-party audits.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

  • Consistent guard-room operations across sites
  • Faster client audits with clean, current documentation and records
  • Predictable incident response with clear escalation and reporting
  • Better SLAs & retention through measured quality and readiness

Frequently Asked Question's

  • Can you standardise operations across all our sites?

    Yes—core SOPs with site-specific addenda so every post runs consistently while respecting local realities.

  • Do you provide the registers and checklists?

    Yes—print-ready and digital templates for visitor, vehicle, key, material, incident, patrol, handover, and more.

  • Who trains the guards and supervisors?

    We run induction & refresher sessions, plus supervisor coaching on documentation and de-escalation.

  • How often do you conduct audits?

    Typically monthly reviews with surprise audits per site; cadence can be adjusted to contracts and risk.

  • Do you cover incident response and escalation?

    Yes—playbooks for common scenarios, call trees, checklists, and drill scripts with post-drill debriefs.

  • Can you align us with buyer programmes (CSR/CTPAT-style)?

    We map your controls to requirements, close gaps, and prepare evidence packs for client or third-party assessments.

  • How do you track corrective actions?

    Every audit produces a CAPA tracker with owners and due dates; we verify closure and record evidence.

  • Can you integrate with our HRMS or use our formats?

    Yes—registers and reports can follow your templates; we’ll also recommend improvements for clarity and auditability.

  • How fast can we see improvements?

    Most SMEs see visible standardisation within 2–6 weeks (pilot site first, then scale).

  • What does it cost?

    After a Security Compliance Review, you’ll receive a proposal based on sites, scope (SOPs/training/audits), and frequency.
